verses.sa:
सत्येनोत्तभिता भूमिः सूर्येणोत्तभिता द्यौः ।
ऋतेनादित्यास्तिष्ठन्ति दिवि सोमो अधि श्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
satyenottabhita bhumih suryenottabhita dyauh |
ritenadityastishthanti divi somo adhi shritah ||
verses.en: By truth is the earth established (ut-stabh); by the sun is the sky established; by righteousness the Ādityas stand; Soma is set (çritá) upon the sky.

verses.sa:
सोमेनादित्या बलिनः सोमेन पृथिवी मही ।
अथो नक्षत्राणामेषामुपस्थे सोम आहितः ॥
verses.rom:
somenaditya balinah somena prithivi mahi |
atho nakshatranameshamupasthe soma ahitah ||
verses.en: By Soma are the Ādityas strong; by Soma is the earth great; likewise in the lap of these asterisms is Soma placed (ā-dhā).

verses.sa:
सोमं मन्यते पपिवान् यत्संपिंषन्त्योषधिम् ।
सोमं यं ब्रह्माणो विदुर्न तस्याश्नाति पार्थिवः ॥
verses.rom:
somam manyate papivan yatsampimshantyoshadhim |
somam yam brahmano vidurna tasyashnati parthivah ||
verses.en: One thinks himself to have drunk Soma when they crush up an herb; what Soma the priests (brahmán) know, of that no earthly man partakes.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वा सोम प्रपिबन्ति तत आ प्यायसे पुनः ।
वायुः सोमस्य रक्षिता समानां मास आकृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yattva soma prapibanti tata a pyayase punah |
vayuh somasya rakshita samanam masa akritih ||
verses.en: When, O Soma, they drink thee up, then thou fillest thyself up again; Vāyu is Soma's defender; the month is norm (ā́kṛti) of the years (sámā).

verses.sa:
आच्छद्विधानैर्गुपितो बार्हतैः सोम रक्षितः ।
ग्राव्णामिच्छृण्वन् तिष्ठसि न ते अश्नाति पार्थिवः ॥
verses.rom:
achchhadvidhanairgupito barhataih soma rakshitah |
gravnamichchhrinvan tishthasi na te ashnati parthivah ||
verses.en: Guarded by covering-arrangements, defended by watchmen (?? bárhata), O Soma, thou standest hearing the pressing-stones; no earthly one partakes of thee.

verses.sa:
चित्तिरा उपबर्हणं चक्षुरा अभ्यञ्जनम् ।
द्यौर्भूमिः कोश आसीद्यदयात्सूर्या पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
chittira upabarhanam chakshura abhyanjanam |
dyaurbhumih kosha asidyadayatsurya patim ||
verses.en: Intention (cítti) was the pillow, sight was the ointment, heaven [and] earth were the coffer (kóça), when Sūryā went to her husband.

verses.sa:
रैभ्यासीदनुदेयी नाराशंसी न्योचनी ।
सूर्याया भद्रमिद्वासो गाथयैति परिष्कृता ॥
verses.rom:
raibhyasidanudeyi narashamsi nyochani |
suryaya bhadramidvaso gathayaiti parishkrita ||
verses.en: The rāíbhī was the parting [song] (?? anudéyī), the nārāçaṅsī́ was the welcoming one (? nyócanī); Sūryā's garment verily was excellent; she goes adorned with song (gā́thā).

verses.sa:
स्तोमा आसन् प्रतिधयः कुरीरं छन्द ओपशः ।
सूर्याया अश्विना वराग्निरासीत्पुरोगवः ॥
verses.rom:
stoma asan pratidhayah kuriram chhanda opashah |
suryaya ashvina varagnirasitpurogavah ||
verses.en: The laudations (stóma) were the cross-pieces (?? pratidhí); meter was the kurī́ra, the opaçá; of Sūryā the Açvins were the wooers, Agni was the forerunner.

verses.sa:
सोमो वधूयुरभवदश्विनास्तामुभा वरा ।
सूर्यां यत्पत्ये शंसन्तीं मनसा सविताददात् ॥
verses.rom:
somo vadhuyurabhavadashvinastamubha vara |
suryam yatpatye shamsantim manasa savitadadat ||
verses.en: Soma was the bride-seeker; both Açvins were wooers, when Savitar gave to her husband Sūryā, praising (çaṅs) with her mind.

verses.sa:
मनो अस्या अन आसीद्द्यौरासीदुत च्छदिः ।
शुक्रावनड्वाहावास्तां यदयात्सूर्या पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
mano asya ana asiddyaurasiduta chchhadih |
shukravanadvahavastam yadayatsurya patim ||
verses.en: Mind was her cart; heaven also was [its] canopy; the two draft-oxen were white (çukrá), when Sūryā went to her husband.

verses.sa:
ऋक्सामाभ्यामभिहितौ गावौ ते सामनावैताम् ।
श्रोत्रे ते चक्रे आस्तां दिवि पन्थाश्चराचरः ॥
verses.rom:
riksamabhyamabhihitau gavau te samanavaitam |
shrotre te chakre astam divi panthashcharacharah ||
verses.en: Haltered with verse (ṛ́c) and chant (sā́man), thy two oxen went peaceful (? sāmaná); ears were thy (two) wheels; in the sky the wandering track.

verses.sa:
शुची ते चक्रे यात्या व्यानो अक्ष आहतः ।
अनो मनस्मयं सूर्यारोहत्प्रयती पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
shuchi te chakre yatya vyano aksha ahatah |
ano manasmayam suryarohatprayati patim ||
verses.en: Clean were the (two) wheels of thee as thou wentest; out-breathing (vyāná) was the inserted axle; a cart made of mind did Sūryā ascend when going forth to her husband.

verses.sa:
सूर्याया वहतुः प्रागात्सविता यमवासृजत्।
मघासु हन्यन्ते गावः फल्गुनीषु व्युह्यते ॥
verses.rom:
suryaya vahatuh pragatsavita yamavasrijat|
maghasu hanyante gavah phalgunishu vyuhyate ||
verses.en: The bridal (vahatú) of Sūryā, which Savitar sent off (ava-sṛj), has gone forth; in the Maghās are slain the kine; in the Phalgunīs is the wedding.

verses.sa:
यदश्विना पृच्छमानावयातं त्रिचक्रेण वहतुं सूर्यायाः ।
क्वैकं चक्रं वामासीत्क्व देष्ट्राय तस्थथुः ॥
verses.rom:
yadashvina prichchhamanavayatam trichakrena vahatum suryayah |
kvaikam chakram vamasitkva deshtraya tasthathuh ||
verses.en: When, O Açvins, ye went asking, with your three-wheeled [chariot], to Sūryā's bridal, where was one wheel of yours? where stood ye for pointing out?

verses.sa:
यदयातं शुभस्पती वरेयं सूर्यामुप ।
विश्वे देवा अनु तद्वामजानन् पुत्रः पितरमवृणीत पूषा ॥
verses.rom:
yadayatam shubhaspati vareyam suryamupa |
vishve deva anu tadvamajanan putrah pitaramavrinita pusha ||
verses.en: When ye went, O lords of beauty, unto the wooing of Sūryā, all the gods assented to that [deed] of yours; Pūshan as son chose a father.

verses.sa:
द्वे ते चक्रे सूर्ये ब्रह्माण ऋतुथा विदुः ।
अथैकं चक्रं यद्गुहा तदद्धातय इद्विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
dve te chakre surye brahmana ritutha viduh |
athaikam chakram yadguha tadaddhataya idviduh ||
verses.en: The two wheels of thee, O Sūryā, the priests (brahmán) know seasonably; further, the one wheel that is in secret—that, verily, the enlightened (addhātí) know.

verses.sa:
अर्यमणं यजामहे सुबन्धुं पतिवेदनम् ।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनात्प्रेतो मुञ्चामि नामुतः ॥
verses.rom:
aryamanam yajamahe subandhum pativedanam |
urvarukamiva bandhanatpreto munchami namutah ||
verses.en: We make offering to Aryaman of good connections, husband-finder; like a gourd from its bond, from here I release, not from yonder.

verses.sa:
प्रेतो मुञ्चामि नामुतः सुबद्धाममुतस्करम् ।
यथेयमिन्द्र मीढ्वः सुपुत्रा सुभगासति ॥
verses.rom:
preto munchami namutah subaddhamamutaskaram |
yatheyamindra midhvah suputra subhagasati ||
verses.en: I release [her] from here, not from yonder; I make her well-bound yonder, that she, O gracious Indra, may be rich in sons, well-portioned.

verses.sa:
प्र त्वा मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशाद्येन त्वाबध्नात्सविता सुशेवाः ।
ऋतस्य योनौ सुकृतस्य लोके स्योनं ते अस्तु सहसंभलायै ॥
verses.rom:
pra tva munchami varunasya pashadyena tvabadhnatsavita sushevah |
ritasya yonau sukritasya loke syonam te astu sahasambhalayai ||
verses.en: I release thee from Varuṇa's fetter, with which the very propitious Savitar bound thee; in the lair (yóni) of righteousness, in the world of the well-done, be it pleasant for thee accompanied by the wooer (-sambhalá).

verses.sa:
भगस्त्वेतो नयतु हस्तगृह्याश्विना त्वा प्र वहतां रथेन ।
गृहान् गच्छ गृहपत्नी यथासो वशिनी त्वं विदथमा वदासि ॥
verses.rom:
bhagastveto nayatu hastagrihyashvina tva pra vahatam rathena |
grihan gachchha grihapatni yathaso vashini tvam vidathama vadasi ||
verses.en: Let Bhaga lead thee hence, grasping thy hand; let the Açvins carry thee forth by a chariot; go to the houses, that thou mayest be housewife; thou, having control, shalt speak unto the council.

verses.sa:
इह प्रियं प्रजायै ते समृध्यतामस्मिन् गृहे गार्हपत्याय जागृहि ।
एना पत्या तन्वं सं स्पृशस्वाथ जिर्विर्विदथमा वदासि ॥
verses.rom:
iha priyam prajayai te samridhyatamasmin grihe garhapatyaya jagrihi |
ena patya tanvam sam sprishasvatha jirvirvidathama vadasi ||
verses.en: Let what is dear succeed (sam-ṛdh) here for thy progeny; watch thou over this house in order to housewife-ship; mingle thy self (tanū́) with this husband; then shalt thou in advanced age speak to the council.

verses.sa:
इहैव स्तं मा वि यौष्टं विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतम् ।
क्रीडन्तौ पुत्रैर्नप्तृभिर्मोदमानौ स्वस्तकौ ॥
verses.rom:
ihaiva stam ma vi yaushtam vishvamayurvyashnutam |
kridantau putrairnaptribhirmodamanau svastakau ||
verses.en: Be ye (two) just here; be not separated; attain your whole lifetime, sporting with sons [and] grandsons, rejoicing, well-homed.

verses.sa:
पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ शिशू क्रीडन्तौ परि यातोऽर्णवम् ।
विश्वान्यो भुवना विचष्ट ऋतूंरन्यो विदधज्जायसे नवः ॥
verses.rom:
purvaparam charato mayayaitau shishu kridantau pari yato'rnavam |
vishvanyo bhuvana vichashta ritumranyo vidadhajjayase navah ||
verses.en: These two move on one after the other by magic; two sporting young ones go about the ocean; the one looks abroad upon all beings; thou, the other, disposing the seasons art born new.

verses.sa:
नवोनवो भवसि जायमानोऽह्नां केतुरुषसामेष्यग्रम् ।
भागं देवेभ्यो वि दधास्यायन् प्र चन्द्रमस्तिरसे दीर्घमायुः ॥
verses.rom:
navonavo bhavasi jayamano'hnam keturushasameshyagram |
bhagam devebhyo vi dadhasyayan pra chandramastirase dirghamayuh ||
verses.en: Ever new art thou, being born; sign of the days, thou goest to the apex of the dawns; thou disposest to the gods their share as thou comest; thou extendest, O moon, a long life-time.

verses.sa:
परा देहि शामुल्यं ब्रह्मभ्यो वि भजा वसु ।
कृत्यैषा पद्वती भूत्वा जाया विशते पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
para dehi shamulyam brahmabhyo vi bhaja vasu |
krityaisha padvati bhutva jaya vishate patim ||
verses.en: Give thou away the çāmulyà; share out goods to the priests (brahmán); it, becoming a walking (padvánt) witchcraft, enters the husband [as] a wife.

verses.sa:
नीललोहितं भवति कृत्यासक्तिर्व्यज्यते ।
एधन्ते अस्या ज्ञातयः पतिर्बन्धेषु बध्यते ॥
verses.rom:
nilalohitam bhavati krityasaktirvyajyate |
edhante asya jnatayah patirbandheshu badhyate ||
verses.en: It becomes blue-red; [as] witchcraft, infection, it is driven away (?); her relations (jñātí) thrive; her husband is bound in bonds.

verses.sa:
अश्लीला तनूर्भवति रुशती पापयामुया ।
पतिर्यद्वध्वो वाससः स्वमङ्गमभ्यूर्णुते ॥
verses.rom:
ashlila tanurbhavati rushati papayamuya |
patiryadvadhvo vasasah svamangamabhyurnute ||
verses.en: Unlovely becomes [his] body, glistening in that evil way, when the husband wraps his own member with the bride's garment.

verses.sa:
आशसनं विशसनमथो अधिविकर्तनम् ।
सूर्यायाः पश्य रूपाणि तानि ब्रह्मोत शुम्भति ॥
verses.rom:
ashasanam vishasanamatho adhivikartanam |
suryayah pashya rupani tani brahmota shumbhati ||
verses.en: Carving on, carving open, also cutting over apart; see the forms of Sūryā; them also the priest (brahmán) cleans (çumbh).

verses.sa:
तृष्टमेतत्कटुकमपाष्ठवद्विषवन् नैतदत्तवे ।
सूर्यां यो ब्रह्मा वेद स इद्वाधूयमर्हति ॥
verses.rom:
trishtametatkatukamapashthavadvishavan naitadattave |
suryam yo brahma veda sa idvadhuyamarhati ||
verses.en: Harsh is that, sharp, barbed, poisoned; that is not to be eaten; what priest (brahmán) knows Sūryā, he indeed deserves the bride's [garment].

verses.sa:
स इत्तत्स्योनं हरति ब्रह्मा वासः सुमङ्गलम् ।
प्रायश्चित्तिं यो अध्येति येन जाया न रिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
sa ittatsyonam harati brahma vasah sumangalam |
prayashchittim yo adhyeti yena jaya na rishyati ||
verses.en: That priest verily takes this garment, pleasant, well-omened, who goes over the expiation, by whom the wife takes no harm.

verses.sa:
युवं भगं सं भरतं समृद्धमृतं वदन्तावृतोद्येषु ।
ब्रह्मणस्पते पतिमस्यै रोचय चारु संभलो वदतु वाचमेताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam bhagam sam bharatam samriddhamritam vadantavritodyeshu |
brahmanaspate patimasyai rochaya charu sambhalo vadatu vachametam ||
verses.en: Do ye (two) bring together a successful (sámṛddha) portion, speaking right in right-speakings; O Brahmaṇaspati, make the husband shine (ruc) for her; let the wooer (sambhalá) speak this speech agreeably (cā́ru).

verses.sa:
इहेदसाथ न परो गमाथेमं गावः प्रजया वर्धयाथ ।
शुभं यतीरुस्रियाः सोमवर्चसो विश्वे देवाः क्रन्न् इह वो मनांसि ॥
verses.rom:
ihedasatha na paro gamathemam gavah prajaya vardhayatha |
shubham yatirusriyah somavarchaso vishve devah krann iha vo manamsi ||
verses.en: May ye be just here; may ye not go away; may ye, O kine, increase this man with progeny; going in beauty, ruddy, with soma-splendor—may all the gods turn (kṛ) your minds hither.

verses.sa:
इमं गावः प्रजया सं विशाथायं देवानां न मिनाति भागम् ।
अस्मै वः पूषा मरुतश्च सर्वे अस्मै वो धाता सविता सुवाति ॥
verses.rom:
imam gavah prajaya sam vishathayam devanam na minati bhagam |
asmai vah pusha marutashcha sarve asmai vo dhata savita suvati ||
verses.en: May ye, O kine, enter this man together with progeny; this man minisheth (mī) not the share of the gods; for this man shall Pūshan, and all the Maruts, for this man shall Dhātar, Savitar quicken (sū) you.

verses.sa:
अनृक्षरा ऋजवः सन्तु पन्थानो येभिः सखायो यन्ति नो वरेयम् ।
सं भगेन समर्यम्णा सं धाता सृजतु वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
anrikshara rijavah santu panthano yebhih sakhayo yanti no vareyam |
sam bhagena samaryamna sam dhata srijatu varchasa ||
verses.en: Free from thorns, straight, let the roads be by which [our] comrades go a-wooing for us; together with Bhaga, together with Aryaman—let Dhātar unite [us] with splendor.

verses.sa:
यच्च वर्चो अक्षेषु सुरायां च यदाहितम् ।
यद्गोष्वश्विना वर्चस्तेनेमां वर्चसावतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yachcha varcho aksheshu surayam cha yadahitam |
yadgoshvashvina varchastenemam varchasavatam ||
verses.en: Both what splendor is placed in dice, and what in strong drink—what splendor, O Açvins, is in kine, with that splendor favor (av) ye this woman.

verses.sa:
येन महानघ्न्या जघनमश्विना येन वा सुरा ।
येनाक्षा अभ्यषिच्यन्त तेनेमां वर्चसावतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yena mahanaghnya jaghanamashvina yena va sura |
yenaksha abhyashichyanta tenemam varchasavatam ||
verses.en: With what [splendor] the backsides of the courtezan (mahānagnī́), O Açvins, or with what the strong drink, with what the dice were flooded (abhi-sic), with that splendor favor ye this woman.

verses.sa:
यो अनिध्मो दीदयदप्स्वन्तर्यं विप्रास ईडते अध्वरेषु ।
अपां नपान् मधुमतीरपो दा याभिरिन्द्रो वावृधे वीर्यावान् ॥
verses.rom:
yo anidhmo didayadapsvantaryam viprasa idate adhvareshu |
apam napan madhumatirapo da yabhirindro vavridhe viryavan ||
verses.en: He who shines (dī) without fuel within the waters, whom the devout (vípra) praise at the sacrifices (adhvará)—O child of the waters, mayest thou give waters rich in honey, with which Indra increased, full of heroism.

verses.sa:
इदमहं रुशन्तं ग्राभं तनूदूषिमपोहामि ।
यो भद्रो रोचनस्तमुदचामि ॥
verses.rom:
idamaham rushantam grabham tanudushimapohami |
yo bhadro rochanastamudachami ||
verses.en: Now do I remove (apa-ūh) the glistening seizer (grābhá), body-spoiling; what sheen is excellent, that I draw up (ud-ac).

verses.sa:
आस्यै ब्राह्मणाः स्नपनीर्हरन्त्ववीरघ्नीरुदजन्त्वापः ।
अर्यम्णो अग्निं पर्येतु पूषन् प्रतीक्षन्ते श्वशुरो देवरश्च ॥
verses.rom:
asyai brahmanah snapanirharantvaviraghnirudajantvapah |
aryamno agnim paryetu pushan pratikshante shvashuro devarashcha ||
verses.en: Let the Brahmans take for her [water] for bathing; let them draw up (?) waters that slay not a hero; let her go about the fire of Aryaman, O Pūshan; father-in-law and brother-in-law are looking on (prati-īkṣ).

verses.sa:
शं ते हिरण्यं शमु सन्त्वापः शं मेथिर्भवतु शं युगस्य तर्द्म ।
शं त आपः शतपवित्रा भवन्तु शमु पत्या तन्वं सं स्पृशस्व ॥
verses.rom:
sham te hiranyam shamu santvapah sham methirbhavatu sham yugasya tardma |
sham ta apah shatapavitra bhavantu shamu patya tanvam sam sprishasva ||
verses.en: Weal be to thee gold, and weal be waters; weal be the post (methí), weal the perforation (tárdman) of the yoke; weal be for thee the waters having a hundred cleansers (-pavítra); for weal, too, mingle thyself with thy husband.

verses.sa:
खे रथस्य खेऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो ।
अपालामिन्द्र त्रिष्पूत्वाकृणोः सूर्यत्वचम् ॥
verses.rom:
khe rathasya khe'nasah khe yugasya shatakrato |
apalamindra trishputvakrinoh suryatvacham ||
verses.en: In the hole of the chariot, in the hole of the cart, in the hole of the yoke, O thou of a hundred activities, having thrice purified Apālā, O Indra, thou didst make her sun-skinned.

verses.sa:
आशासाना सौमनसं प्रजां सौभाग्यं रयिम् ।
पत्युरनुव्रता भूत्वा सं नह्यस्वामृताय कम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashasana saumanasam prajam saubhagyam rayim |
patyuranuvrata bhutva sam nahyasvamritaya kam ||
verses.en: Hoping for well-willing, offspring, good-fortune, wealth, becoming obedient (ánuvrata) to thy husband, gird thyself in order to immortality.

verses.sa:
यथा सिन्धुर्नदीनां साम्राज्यं सुषुवे वृषा ।
एवा त्वं सम्राज्ञ्येधि पत्युरस्तं परेत्य ॥
verses.rom:
yatha sindhurnadinam samrajyam sushuve vrisha |
eva tvam samrajnyedhi patyurastam paretya ||
verses.en: As the mighty (? vṛ́ṣā) river (síndhu) won (? sū) the supremacy of the streams (nadī́), so be thou supreme (samrā́jñī), having gone away to thy husband's home.

verses.sa:
सम्राज्ञ्येधि श्वशुरेषु सम्राज्ञ्युत देवृषु ।
ननान्दुः सम्राज्ञ्येधि सम्राज्ञ्युत श्वश्र्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
samrajnyedhi shvashureshu samrajnyuta devrishu |
nananduh samrajnyedhi samrajnyuta shvashrvah ||
verses.en: Be thou supreme among fathers-in-law, supreme also among brothers-in-law; be thou supreme over sister-in-law, supreme also over mother-in-law.

verses.sa:
या अकृन्तन्न् अवयन् याश्च तत्निरे या देवीरन्तामभितोऽददन्त ।
तास्त्वा जरसे सं व्ययन्त्वायुष्मतीदं परि धत्स्व वासः ॥
verses.rom:
ya akrintann avayan yashcha tatnire ya devirantamabhito'dadanta |
tastva jarase sam vyayantvayushmatidam pari dhatsva vasah ||
verses.en: They (f.) who spun, wove, and who stretched [the web], what divine ones (f.) gave the ends about, let them wrap thee in order to old age; [as] one long-lived put about thee this garment.

verses.sa:
जीवं रुदन्ति वि नयन्त्यध्वरं दीर्घामनु प्रसितिं दीध्युर्नरः ।
वामं पितृभ्यो य इदं समीरिरे मयः पतिभ्यो जनये परिष्वजे ॥
verses.rom:
jivam rudanti vi nayantyadhvaram dirghamanu prasitim didhyurnarah |
vamam pitribhyo ya idam samirire mayah patibhyo janaye parishvaje ||
verses.en: They bewail the living one (m.); they lead away the sacrifice (adhvará); the men sent their thoughts after root dhī...ánu a long reach (prásiti); what is lovely (vāmá) for the Fathers who came together here; joy to the husbands for embracing the wife.

verses.sa:
स्योनं ध्रुवं प्रजायै धारयामि तेऽश्मानं देव्याः पृथिव्या उपस्थे ।
तमा तिष्ठानुमाद्या सुवर्चा दीर्घं त आयुः सविता कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
syonam dhruvam prajayai dharayami te'shmanam devyah prithivya upasthe |
tama tishthanumadya suvarcha dirgham ta ayuh savita krinotu ||
verses.en: I maintain for thee, in order to progeny, a pleasant, firm (dhruvá) stone in the lap of the divine earth; stand thou on that, one to be exulted after, of excellent glory; let Savitar make for thee a long life-time.

verses.sa:
येनाग्निरस्या भूम्या हस्तं जग्राह दक्षिणम् ।
तेन गृह्णामि ते हस्तं मा व्यथिष्ठा मया सह प्रजया च धनेन च ॥
verses.rom:
yenagnirasya bhumya hastam jagraha dakshinam |
tena grihnami te hastam ma vyathishtha maya saha prajaya cha dhanena cha ||
verses.en: Wherewith Agni grasped the right hand of this earth, therewith grasp I thy hand; do not stagger in company with me, with both progeny and riches.

verses.sa:
देवस्ते सविता हस्तं गृह्णातु सोमो राजा सुप्रजसं कृणोतु ।
अग्निः सुभगां जतवेदाः पत्ये पत्नीं जरदष्टिं कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
devaste savita hastam grihnatu somo raja suprajasam krinotu |
agnih subhagam jatavedah patye patnim jaradashtim krinotu ||
verses.en: Let god Savitar grasp thy hand; let king Soma make thee to have good offspring; let Agni, Jātavedas, make the spouse well-portioned, long-lived, for her husband.

verses.sa:
गृह्णामि ते सौभगत्वाय हस्तं मया पत्या जरदष्टिर्यथासः ।
भगो अर्यमा सविता पुरंधिर्मह्यं त्वादुर्गार्हपत्याय देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
grihnami te saubhagatvaya hastam maya patya jaradashtiryathasah |
bhago aryama savita puramdhirmahyam tvadurgarhapatyaya devah ||
verses.en: I grasp thy hand in order to good-fortune, that with me as husband thou mayest be long-lived; Bhaga, Aryaman, Savitar, Purandhi púraṁdhi—the gods have given thee to me in order to housewifeship.

verses.sa:
भगस्ते हस्तमग्रहीत्सविता हस्तमग्रहीत्।
पत्नी त्वमसि धर्मणाहं गृहपतिस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
bhagaste hastamagrahitsavita hastamagrahit|
patni tvamasi dharmanaham grihapatistava ||
verses.en: Bhaga hath grasped thy hand; Savitar hath grasped thy hand; thou art [my] spouse by ordinance (dhárman), I thy house-lord.

verses.sa:
ममेयमस्तु पोष्या मह्यं त्वादाद्बृहस्पतिः ।
मया पत्या प्रजावति सं जीव शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
mameyamastu poshya mahyam tvadadbrihaspatih |
maya patya prajavati sam jiva sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: Be this woman mine, bringing prosperity (pósya); Brihaspati hath given thee to me; in company with me as husband do thou live, rich in offspring, a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा वासो व्यदधाच्छुभे कं बृहस्पतेः प्रशिषा कवीनाम् ।
तेनेमां नारीं सविता भगश्च सूर्यामिव परि धत्तां प्रजया ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta vaso vyadadhachchhubhe kam brihaspateh prashisha kavinam |
tenemam narim savita bhagashcha suryamiva pari dhattam prajaya ||
verses.en: Tvashṭar disposed (vi-dhā) the garment for beauty, by direction of Brihaspati, of the poets; therewith let Savitar and Bhaga envelop this woman, like Sūryā, with progeny.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी द्यावापृथिवी मातरिश्वा मित्रावरुणा भगो अश्विनोभा ।
बृहस्पतिर्मरुतो ब्रह्म सोम इमां नारिं प्रजया वर्धयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
indragni dyavaprithivi matarishva mitravaruna bhago ashvinobha |
brihaspatirmaruto brahma soma imam narim prajaya vardhayantu ||
verses.en: Let Indra-and-Agni, heaven-and-earth, Mātariçvan, Mitra-and-Varuṇa, Bhaga, both Açvins, Brihaspati, the Maruts, the bráhman. Soma, increase this woman with progeny.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिः प्रथमः सूर्यायाः शीर्षे केशाँ अकल्पयत्।
तेनेमामश्विना नारीं पत्ये सं शोभयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatih prathamah suryayah shirshe keshan akalpayat|
tenemamashvina narim patye sam shobhayamasi ||
verses.en: Brihaspati first prepared (kḷp) the hairs on the head of Sūryā; with this, O Açvins, do we thoroughly adorn (çubh) this woman for her husband.

verses.sa:
इदं तद्रूपं यदवस्त योषा जायां जिज्ञासे मनसा चरन्तीम् ।
तामन्वर्तिष्ये सखिभिर्नवग्वैः क इमान् विद्वान् वि चचर्त पाशान् ॥
verses.rom:
idam tadrupam yadavasta yosha jayam jijnase manasa charantim |
tamanvartishye sakhibhirnavagvaih ka iman vidvan vi chacharta pashan ||
verses.en: This [is] that form in which the young woman (yóṣā) dressed herself; I desire to know with [my] mind the wife (jāyá) moving about; I will go after her with nine-fold (? návagva) comrades: who, knowing, unloosened (vi-cṛt) these fetters?

verses.sa:
अहं वि ष्यामि मयि रूपमस्या वेददित्पश्यन् मनसः कुलायम् ।
न स्तेयमद्मि मनसोदमुच्ये स्वयं श्रथ्नानो वरुणस्य पाशान् ॥
verses.rom:
aham vi shyami mayi rupamasya vedaditpashyan manasah kulayam |
na steyamadmi manasodamuchye svayam shrathnano varunasya pashan ||
verses.en: I loosen (vi-sā) in me the form of her; he verily shall know, seeing the nest of mind; I eat not stolenly; I was freed (ud-muc) by mind, myself untying (çrath) the fetters of Varuṇa.

verses.sa:
प्र त्वा मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशाद्येन त्वाबध्नात्सविता सुशेवाः ।
उरुं लोकं सुगमत्र पन्थां कृणोमि तुभ्यं सहपत्न्यै वधु ॥
verses.rom:
pra tva munchami varunasya pashadyena tvabadhnatsavita sushevah |
urum lokam sugamatra pantham krinomi tubhyam sahapatnyai vadhu ||
verses.en: I release thee from Varuṇa's fetter, with which the very propitious Savitar bound thee; wide space (loká), an easy road here, do I make for thee, O bride (vadhū́), with thy husband.

verses.sa:
उद्यच्छध्वमप रक्षो हनाथेमं नारीं सुकृते दधात ।
धाता विपश्चित्पतिमस्यै विवेद भगो राजा पुर एतु प्रजानन् ॥
verses.rom:
udyachchhadhvamapa raksho hanathemam narim sukrite dadhata |
dhata vipashchitpatimasyai viveda bhago raja pura etu prajanan ||
verses.en: Raise ye [your weapons]; may ye smite away the demon; set this woman in what is well done; inspired Dhātar found for her a husband; let king Bhaga go in front, foreknowing.

verses.sa:
भगस्ततक्ष चतुरः पादान् भगस्ततक्ष चत्वार्युष्पलानि ।
त्वष्टा पिपेश मध्यतोऽनु वर्ध्रान्त्सा नो अस्तु सुमङ्गली ॥
verses.rom:
bhagastataksha chaturah padan bhagastataksha chatvaryushpalani |
tvashta pipesha madhyato'nu vardhrantsa no astu sumangali ||
verses.en: Bhaga fashioned the four feet; Bhaga fashioned the four frame-pieces (? úṣyala); Tvashṭar adorned (piç) the straps (? várdhra) along in the middle; let her be to us of excellent omen.

verses.sa:
सुकिंशुकं वहतुं विश्वरूपं हिरण्यवर्णं सुवृतं सुचक्रम् ।
आ रोह सूर्ये अमृतस्य लोकं स्योनं पतिभ्यो वहतुं कृणु त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
sukimshukam vahatum vishvarupam hiranyavarnam suvritam suchakram |
a roha surye amritasya lokam syonam patibhyo vahatum krinu tvam ||
verses.en: The well-flowered (sukiṅçuká), all-formed bridal-car (vahatú), golden-colored, well-rolling, well-wheeled, do thou mount, O Sūryā, to the world of the immortal; make thou a bridal -car pleasant to husbands.

verses.sa:
अभ्रातृघ्नीं वरुणापशुघ्नीं बृहस्पते ।
इन्द्रापतिघ्नीं पुत्रिणीमास्मभ्यं सवितर्वह ॥
verses.rom:
abhratrighnim varunapashughnim brihaspate |
indrapatighnim putrinimasmabhyam savitarvaha ||
verses.en: Her, not brother-slaying, O Varuṇa; not cattle-slaying, O Brihaspati; not husband-slaying, possessing sons, O Indra—bring [her] for us, O Savitar.

verses.sa:
मा हिंसिष्टं कुमार्यं स्थूणे देवकृते पथि ।
शालाया देव्या द्वारं स्योनं कृण्मो वधूपथम् ॥
verses.rom:
ma himsishtam kumaryam sthune devakrite pathi |
shalaya devya dvaram syonam krinmo vadhupatham ||
verses.en: Injure ye not the maiden (kumārī́), ye (two) pillars, on the god-made road; the door of the divine house we make pleasant, a road for the bride.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मापरं युज्यतां ब्रह्म पूर्वं ब्रह्मान्ततो मध्यतो ब्रह्म सर्वतः ।
अनाव्याधां देवपुरां प्रपद्य शिवा स्योना पतिलोके वि राज ॥
verses.rom:
brahmaparam yujyatam brahma purvam brahmantato madhyato brahma sarvatah |
anavyadham devapuram prapadya shiva syona patiloke vi raja ||
verses.en: Let the bráhman be yoked after, the bráhman before, the bráhman at the end, in the middle, the bráhman everywhere; going forward to an impenetrable stronghold of the gods, do thou (f.), propitious, pleasant, bear rule in thy husband's world.

verses.sa:
(विवाह प्रकरणम्)
तुभ्यमग्रे पर्यवहन्त्सूर्यां वहतुना सह ।
स नः पतिभ्यो जायां दा अग्ने प्रजया सह ॥
verses.rom:
(vivaha prakaranam)
tubhyamagre paryavahantsuryam vahatuna saha |
sa nah patibhyo jayam da agne prajaya saha ||

verses.sa:
पुनः पत्नीमग्निरदादायुषा सह वर्चसा ।
दीर्घायुरस्या यः पतिर्जीवाति शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
punah patnimagniradadayusha saha varchasa |
dirghayurasya yah patirjivati sharadah shatam ||

verses.sa:
सोमस्य जाया प्रथमं गन्धर्वस्तेऽपरः पतिः ।
तृतीयो अग्निष्टे पतिस्तुरीयस्ते मनुष्यजाः ॥
verses.rom:
somasya jaya prathamam gandharvaste'parah patih |
tritiyo agnishte patisturiyaste manushyajah ||

verses.sa:
सोमो ददद्गन्धर्वाय गन्धर्वो दददग्नये ।
रयिं च पुत्रांश्चादादग्निर्मह्यमथो इमाम् ॥
verses.rom:
somo dadadgandharvaya gandharvo dadadagnaye |
rayim cha putramshchadadagnirmahyamatho imam ||

verses.sa:
आ वामगन्त्सुमतिर्वाजिनीवसू न्यश्विना हृत्सु कामा अरंसत ।
अभूतं गोपा मिथुना शुभस्पती प्रिया अर्यम्णो दुर्यामशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
a vamagantsumatirvajinivasu nyashvina hritsu kama aramsata |
abhutam gopa mithuna shubhaspati priya aryamno duryamashimahi ||

verses.sa:
सा मन्दसाना मनसा शिवेन रयिं धेहि सर्ववीरं वचस्यम् ।
सुगं तीर्थं सुप्रपाणं शुभस्पती स्थाणुं पथिष्ठामप दुर्मतिं हतम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa mandasana manasa shivena rayim dhehi sarvaviram vachasyam |
sugam tirtham suprapanam shubhaspati sthanum pathishthamapa durmatim hatam ||

verses.sa:
या ओषधयो या नद्यो यानि क्षेत्राणि या वना ।
तास्त्वा वधु प्रजावतीं पत्ये रक्षन्तु रक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
ya oshadhayo ya nadyo yani kshetrani ya vana |
tastva vadhu prajavatim patye rakshantu rakshasah ||

verses.sa:
एमं पन्थामरुक्षाम सुगं स्वस्तिवाहनम् ।
यस्मिन् वीरो न रिष्यत्यन्येषां विन्दते वसु ॥
verses.rom:
emam panthamarukshama sugam svastivahanam |
yasmin viro na rishyatyanyesham vindate vasu ||

verses.sa:
इदं सु मे नरः शृणुत ययाशिषा दंपती वाममश्नुतः ।
ये गन्धर्वा अप्सरसश्च देवीरेषु वानस्पत्येषु येऽधि तस्थुः ।
स्योनास्ते अस्यै वध्वै भवन्तु मा हिंसिषुर्वहतुमुह्यमानम् ॥
verses.rom:
idam su me narah shrinuta yayashisha dampati vamamashnutah |
ye gandharva apsarasashcha devireshu vanaspatyeshu ye'dhi tasthuh |
syonaste asyai vadhvai bhavantu ma himsishurvahatumuhyamanam ||

verses.sa:
ये वध्वश्चन्द्रं वहतुं यक्ष्मा यन्ति जनामनु ।
पुनस्तान् यज्ञिया देवा नयन्तु यत आगताः ॥
verses.rom:
ye vadhvashchandram vahatum yakshma yanti janamanu |
punastan yajniya deva nayantu yata agatah ||

verses.sa:
मा विदन् परिपन्थिनो य आसीदन्ति दंपती ।
सुगेन दुर्गमतीतामप द्रान्त्वरातयः ॥
verses.rom:
ma vidan paripanthino ya asidanti dampati |
sugena durgamatitamapa drantvaratayah ||

verses.sa:
सं काशयामि वहतुं ब्रह्मणा गृहैरघोरेण चक्षुषा मित्रियेण ।
पर्याणद्धं विश्वरूपं यदस्ति स्योनं पतिभ्यः सविता तत्कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
sam kashayami vahatum brahmana grihairaghorena chakshusha mitriyena |
paryanaddham vishvarupam yadasti syonam patibhyah savita tatkrinotu ||

verses.sa:
शिवा नारीयमस्तमागन्न् इमं धाता लोकमस्यै दिदेश ।
तामर्यमा भगो अश्विनोभा प्रजापतिः प्रजया वर्धयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
shiva nariyamastamagann imam dhata lokamasyai didesha |
tamaryama bhago ashvinobha prajapatih prajaya vardhayantu ||

verses.sa:
आत्मन्वत्युर्वरा नारीयमागन् तस्यां नरो वपत बीजमस्याम् ।
सा वः प्रजां जनयद्वक्षणाभ्यो बिभ्रती दुग्धमृषभस्य रेतः ॥
verses.rom:
atmanvatyurvara nariyamagan tasyam naro vapata bijamasyam |
sa vah prajam janayadvakshanabhyo bibhrati dugdhamrishabhasya retah ||

verses.sa:
प्रति तिष्ठ विराडसि विष्णुरिवेह सरस्वति ।
सिनीवालि प्र जायतां भगस्य सुमतावसत् ॥
verses.rom:
prati tishtha viradasi vishnuriveha sarasvati |
sinivali pra jayatam bhagasya sumatavasat ||

verses.sa:
उद्व ऊर्मिः शम्या हन्त्वापो योक्त्राणि मुञ्चत ।
मादुष्कृतौ व्येनसावघ्न्यावशुनमारताम् ॥
verses.rom:
udva urmih shamya hantvapo yoktrani munchata |
madushkritau vyenasavaghnyavashunamaratam ||

verses.sa:
अघोरचक्षुरपतिघ्नी स्योना शग्मा सुशेवा सुयमा गृहेभ्यः ।
वीरसूर्देवृकामा सं त्वयैधिषीमहि सुमस्यमाना ॥
verses.rom:
aghorachakshurapatighni syona shagma susheva suyama grihebhyah |
virasurdevrikama sam tvayaidhishimahi sumasyamana ||

verses.sa:
अदेवृघ्न्यपतिघ्नीहैधि शिवा पशुभ्यः सुयमा सुवर्चाः ।
प्रजावती वीरसूर्देवृकामा स्योनेममग्निं गार्हपत्यं सपर्य ॥
verses.rom:
adevrighnyapatighnihaidhi shiva pashubhyah suyama suvarchah |
prajavati virasurdevrikama syonemamagnim garhapatyam saparya ||

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठेतः किमिच्छन्तीदमागा अहं त्वेडे अभिभूः स्वाद्गृहात्।
शून्यैषी निर्ऋते याजगन्थोत्तिष्ठाराते प्र पत मेह रंस्थाः ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthetah kimichchhantidamaga aham tvede abhibhuh svadgrihat|
shunyaishi nirrite yajaganthottishtharate pra pata meha ramsthah ||

verses.sa:
यदा गार्हपत्यमसपर्यैत्पूर्वमग्निं वधूरियम् ।
अधा सरस्वत्यै नारि पितृभ्यश्च नमस्कुरु ॥
verses.rom:
yada garhapatyamasaparyaitpurvamagnim vadhuriyam |
adha sarasvatyai nari pitribhyashcha namaskuru ||

verses.sa:
शर्म वर्मैतदा हरास्यै नार्या उपस्तिरे ।
सिनीवालि प्र जायतां भगस्य सुमतावसत् ॥
verses.rom:
sharma varmaitada harasyai narya upastire |
sinivali pra jayatam bhagasya sumatavasat ||

verses.sa:
यं बल्बजं न्यस्यथ चर्म चोपस्तृणीथन ।
तदा रोहतु सुप्रजा या कन्या विन्दते पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam balbajam nyasyatha charma chopastrinithana |
tada rohatu supraja ya kanya vindate patim ||

verses.sa:
उप स्तृणीहि बल्बजमधि चर्मणि रोहिते ।
तत्रोपविश्य सुप्रजा इममग्निं सपर्यतु ॥
verses.rom:
upa strinihi balbajamadhi charmani rohite |
tatropavishya supraja imamagnim saparyatu ||

verses.sa:
आ रोह चर्मोप सीदाग्निमेष देवो हन्ति रक्षांसि सर्वा ।
इह प्रजां जनय पत्ये अस्मै सुज्यैष्ठ्यो भवत्पुत्रस्त एषः ॥
verses.rom:
a roha charmopa sidagnimesha devo hanti rakshamsi sarva |
iha prajam janaya patye asmai sujyaishthyo bhavatputrasta eshah ||

verses.sa:
वि तिष्ठन्तां मातुरस्या उपस्थान् नानारूपाः पशवो जायमानाः ।
सुमङ्गल्युप सीदेममग्निं संपत्नी प्रति भूषेह देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
vi tishthantam maturasya upasthan nanarupah pashavo jayamanah |
sumangalyupa sidemamagnim sampatni prati bhusheha devan ||

verses.sa:
सुमङ्गली प्रतरणी गृहाणां सुशेवा पत्ये श्वशुराय शंभूः ।
स्योना श्वश्र्वै प्र गृहान् विशेमान् ॥
verses.rom:
sumangali pratarani grihanam susheva patye shvashuraya shambhuh |
syona shvashrvai pra grihan visheman ||

verses.sa:
स्योना भव श्वशुरेभ्यः स्योना पत्ये गृहेभ्यः ।
स्योनास्यै सर्वस्यै विशे स्योना पुष्टायैषां भव ॥
verses.rom:
syona bhava shvashurebhyah syona patye grihebhyah |
syonasyai sarvasyai vishe syona pushtayaisham bhava ||

verses.sa:
सुमङ्गलीरियं वधूरिमां समेत पश्यत ।
सौभाग्यमस्यै दत्त्वा दौर्भाग्यैर्विपरेतन ॥
verses.rom:
sumangaliriyam vadhurimam sameta pashyata |
saubhagyamasyai dattva daurbhagyairviparetana ||

verses.sa:
या दुर्हार्दो युवतयो याश्चेह जरतीरपि ।
वर्चो न्वस्यै सं दत्ताथास्तं विपरेतन ॥
verses.rom:
ya durhardo yuvatayo yashcheha jaratirapi |
varcho nvasyai sam dattathastam viparetana ||

verses.sa:
रुक्मप्रस्तरणं वह्यं विश्वा रूपाणि बिभ्रतम् ।
आरोहत्सूर्या सावित्री बृहते सौभगाय कम् ॥
verses.rom:
rukmaprastaranam vahyam vishva rupani bibhratam |
arohatsurya savitri brihate saubhagaya kam ||

verses.sa:
आ रोह तल्पं सुमनस्यमानेह प्रजां जनय पत्ये अस्मै ।
इन्द्राणीव सुबुधा बुध्यमाना ज्योतिरग्रा उषसः प्रति जागरासि ॥
verses.rom:
a roha talpam sumanasyamaneha prajam janaya patye asmai |
indraniva subudha budhyamana jyotiragra ushasah prati jagarasi ||

verses.sa:
देवा अग्रे न्यपद्यन्त पत्नीः समस्पृशन्त तन्वस्तनूभिः ।
सूर्येव नारि विश्वरूपा महित्वा प्रजावती पत्या सं भवेह ॥
verses.rom:
deva agre nyapadyanta patnih samasprishanta tanvastanubhih |
suryeva nari vishvarupa mahitva prajavati patya sam bhaveha ||

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठेतो विश्वावसो नमसेडामहे त्वा ।
जामिमिच्छ पितृषदं न्यक्तां स ते भागो जनुषा तस्य विद्धि ॥
verses.rom:
uttishtheto vishvavaso namasedamahe tva |
jamimichchha pitrishadam nyaktam sa te bhago janusha tasya viddhi ||

verses.sa:
अप्सरसः सधमादं मदन्ति हविर्धानमन्तरा सूर्यं च ।
तास्ते जनित्रमभि ताः परेहि नमस्ते गन्धर्वर्तुना कृणोमि ॥
verses.rom:
apsarasah sadhamadam madanti havirdhanamantara suryam cha |
taste janitramabhi tah parehi namaste gandharvartuna krinomi ||

verses.sa:
नमो गन्धर्वस्य नमसे नमो भामाय चक्षुषे च कृण्मः ।
विश्वावसो ब्रह्मणा ते नमोऽभि जाया अप्सरसः परेहि ॥
verses.rom:
namo gandharvasya namase namo bhamaya chakshushe cha krinmah |
vishvavaso brahmana te namo'bhi jaya apsarasah parehi ||

verses.sa:
राया वयं सुमनसः स्यामोदितो गन्धर्वमावीवृताम ।
अगन्त्स देवः परमं सधस्थमगन्म यत्र प्रतिरन्त आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
raya vayam sumanasah syamodito gandharvamavivritama |
agantsa devah paramam sadhasthamaganma yatra pratiranta ayuh ||

verses.sa:
सं पितरावृत्विये सृजेथां माता पिता च रेतसो भवाथः ।
मर्य इव योषामधि रोहयैनां प्रजां कृण्वाथामिह पुष्यतं रयिम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam pitaravritviye srijetham mata pita cha retaso bhavathah |
marya iva yoshamadhi rohayainam prajam krinvathamiha pushyatam rayim ||

verses.sa:
तां पूषं छिवतमामेरयस्व यस्यां बीजं मनुष्या वपन्ति ।
या न ऊरू उशती विश्रयाति यस्यामुशन्तः प्रहरेम शेपः ॥
verses.rom:
tam pusham chhivatamamerayasva yasyam bijam manushya vapanti |
ya na uru ushati vishrayati yasyamushantah praharema shepah ||

verses.sa:
आ रोहोरुमुप धत्स्व हस्तं परि ष्वजस्व जायां सुमनस्यमानः ।
प्रजां कृण्वाथामिह मोदमानौ दीर्घं वामायुः सविता कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
a rohorumupa dhatsva hastam pari shvajasva jayam sumanasyamanah |
prajam krinvathamiha modamanau dirgham vamayuh savita krinotu ||

verses.sa:
आ वां प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिरहोरात्राभ्यां समनक्त्वर्यमा ।
अदुर्मङ्गली पतिलोकमा विशेमं शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
a vam prajam janayatu prajapatirahoratrabhyam samanaktvaryama |
adurmangali patilokama vishemam sham no bhava dvipade sham chatushpade ||

verses.sa:
देवैर्दत्तं मनुना साकमेतद्वाधूयं वासो वध्वश्च वस्त्रम् ।
यो ब्रह्मणे चिकितुषे ददाति स इद्रक्षांसि तल्पानि हन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
devairdattam manuna sakametadvadhuyam vaso vadhvashcha vastram |
yo brahmane chikitushe dadati sa idrakshamsi talpani hanti ||

verses.sa:
यं मे दत्तो ब्रह्मभागं वधूयोर्वाधूयं वासो वध्वश्च वस्त्रम् ।
युवं ब्रह्मणेऽनुमन्यमानौ बृहस्पते साकमिन्द्रश्च दत्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam me datto brahmabhagam vadhuyorvadhuyam vaso vadhvashcha vastram |
yuvam brahmane'numanyamanau brihaspate sakamindrashcha dattam ||

verses.sa:
स्योनाद्योनेरधि बध्यमानौ हसामुदौ महसा मोदमानौ ।
सुगू सुपुत्रौ सुगृहौ तराथो जीवावुषसो विभातीः ॥
verses.rom:
syonadyoneradhi badhyamanau hasamudau mahasa modamanau |
sugu suputrau sugrihau taratho jivavushaso vibhatih ||

verses.sa:
नवं वसानः सुरभिः सुवासा उदागां जीव उषसो विभातीः ।
आण्डात्पतत्रीवामुक्षि विश्वस्मादेनसस्परि ॥
verses.rom:
navam vasanah surabhih suvasa udagam jiva ushaso vibhatih |
andatpatatrivamukshi vishvasmadenasaspari ||

verses.sa:
शुम्भनी द्यावापृथिवी अन्तिसुम्ने महिव्रते ।
आपः सप्त सुस्रुवुर्देवीस्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
shumbhani dyavaprithivi antisumne mahivrate |
apah sapta susruvurdevista no munchantvamhasah ||

verses.sa:
सूर्यायै देवेभ्यो मित्राय वरुणाय च ।
ये भूतस्य प्रचेतसस्तेभ्य इदमकरं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
suryayai devebhyo mitraya varunaya cha |
ye bhutasya prachetasastebhya idamakaram namah ||

verses.sa:
य ऋते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः ।
संधाता संधिं मघवा पुरूवसुर्निष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
ya rite chidabhishrishah pura jatrubhya atridah |
samdhata samdhim maghava puruvasurnishkarta vihrutam punah ||

verses.sa:
अपास्मत्तम उच्छतु नीलं पिशङ्गमुत लोहितं यत्।
निर्दहनी या पृषातक्यस्मिन् तां स्थाणावध्या सजामि ॥
verses.rom:
apasmattama uchchhatu nilam pishangamuta lohitam yat|
nirdahani ya prishatakyasmin tam sthanavadhya sajami ||

verses.sa:
यावतीः कृत्या उपवासने यावन्तो राज्ञो वरुणस्य पाशाः ।
व्यृद्धयो या असमृद्धयो या अस्मिन् ता स्थाणावधि सादयामि ॥
verses.rom:
yavatih kritya upavasane yavanto rajno varunasya pashah |
vyriddhayo ya asamriddhayo ya asmin ta sthanavadhi sadayami ||

verses.sa:
या मे प्रियतमा तनूः सा मे बिभाय वाससः ।
तस्याग्रे त्वं वनस्पते नीविं कृणुष्व मा वयं रिषाम ॥
verses.rom:
ya me priyatama tanuh sa me bibhaya vasasah |
tasyagre tvam vanaspate nivim krinushva ma vayam rishama ||

verses.sa:
ये अन्ता यावतीः सिचो य ओतवो ये च तन्तवः ।
वासो यत्पत्नीभिरुतं तन् न स्योनमुप स्पृशात् ॥
verses.rom:
ye anta yavatih sicho ya otavo ye cha tantavah |
vaso yatpatnibhirutam tan na syonamupa sprishat ||

verses.sa:
उशतीः कन्यला इमाः पितृलोकात्पतिं यतीः ।
अव दीक्षामसृक्षत स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
ushatih kanyala imah pitrilokatpatim yatih |
ava dikshamasrikshata svaha ||

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन् ।
वर्चो गोषु प्रविष्टं यत्तेनेमां सं सृजामसि ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatinavasrishtam vishve deva adharayan |
varcho goshu pravishtam yattenemam sam srijamasi ||

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन् ।
तेजो गोषु प्रविष्टं यत्तेनेमां सं सृजामसि ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatinavasrishtam vishve deva adharayan |
tejo goshu pravishtam yattenemam sam srijamasi ||

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन् ।
भजो गोषु प्रविष्टो यस्तेनेमां सं सृजामसि ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatinavasrishtam vishve deva adharayan |
bhajo goshu pravishto yastenemam sam srijamasi ||

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन् ।
यशो गोषु प्रविष्टं यत्तेनेमां सं सृजामसि ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatinavasrishtam vishve deva adharayan |
yasho goshu pravishtam yattenemam sam srijamasi ||

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन् ।
पयो गोषु प्रविष्टं यत्तेनेमां सं सृजामसि ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatinavasrishtam vishve deva adharayan |
payo goshu pravishtam yattenemam sam srijamasi ||

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिनावसृष्टां विश्वे देवा अधारयन् ।
रसो गोषु प्रविष्टो यस्तेनेमां सं सृजामसि ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatinavasrishtam vishve deva adharayan |
raso goshu pravishto yastenemam sam srijamasi ||

verses.sa:
यदीमे केशिनो जना गृहे ते समनर्तिषू रोदेन कृण्वन्तोऽघम् ।
अग्निष्ट्वा तस्मादेनसः सविता च प्र मुञ्चताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadime keshino jana grihe te samanartishu rodena krinvanto'gham |
agnishtva tasmadenasah savita cha pra munchatam ||

verses.sa:
यदीयं दुहिता तव विकेश्यरुदद्गृहे रोदेन कृण्वत्यघम् ।
अग्निष्ट्वा तस्मादेनसः सविता च प्र मुञ्चताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadiyam duhita tava vikeshyarudadgrihe rodena krinvatyagham |
agnishtva tasmadenasah savita cha pra munchatam ||

verses.sa:
यज्जामयो यद्युवतयो गृहे ते समनर्तिषू रोदेन कृण्वतीरघम् ।
अग्निष्ट्वा तस्मादेनसः सविता च प्र मुञ्चताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajjamayo yadyuvatayo grihe te samanartishu rodena krinvatiragham |
agnishtva tasmadenasah savita cha pra munchatam ||

verses.sa:
यत्ते प्रजायां पशुषु यद्वा गृहेषु निष्ठितमघकृद्भिरघं कृतम् ।
अग्निष्ट्वा तस्मादेनसः सविता च प्र मुञ्चताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatte prajayam pashushu yadva griheshu nishthitamaghakridbhiragham kritam |
agnishtva tasmadenasah savita cha pra munchatam ||

verses.sa:
इयं नार्युप ब्रूते पूल्यान्यावपन्तिका ।
दीर्घायुरस्तु मे पतिर्जीवाति शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
iyam naryupa brute pulyanyavapantika |
dirghayurastu me patirjivati sharadah shatam ||

verses.sa:
इहेमाविन्द्र सं नुद चक्रवाकेव दंपती ।
प्रजयैनौ स्वस्तकौ विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ihemavindra sam nuda chakravakeva dampati |
prajayainau svastakau vishvamayurvyashnutam ||

verses.sa:
यदासन्द्यामुपधाने यद्वोपवासने कृतम् ।
विवाहे कृत्यां यां चक्रुरास्नाने तां नि दध्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
yadasandyamupadhane yadvopavasane kritam |
vivahe krityam yam chakrurasnane tam ni dadhmasi ||

verses.sa:
यद्दुष्कृतं यच्छमलं विवाहे वहतौ च यत्।
तत्संभलस्य कम्बले मृज्महे दुरितं वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaddushkritam yachchhamalam vivahe vahatau cha yat|
tatsambhalasya kambale mrijmahe duritam vayam ||

verses.sa:
संभले मलं सादयित्वा कम्बले दुरितं वयम् ।
अभूम यज्ञियाः शुद्धाः प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
sambhale malam sadayitva kambale duritam vayam |
abhuma yajniyah shuddhah pra na ayumshi tarishat ||

verses.sa:
कृत्रिमः कण्टकः शतदन् य एषः ।
अपास्याः केश्यं मलमप शीर्षण्यं लिखात् ॥
verses.rom:
kritrimah kantakah shatadan ya eshah |
apasyah keshyam malamapa shirshanyam likhat ||

verses.sa:
अङ्गादङ्गाद्वयमस्या अप यक्ष्मं नि दध्मसि ।
तन् मा प्रापत्पृथिवीं मोत देवान् दिवं मा प्रापदुर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
अपो मा प्रापन् मलमेतदग्ने यमं मा प्रापत्पितॄंश्च सर्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
angadangadvayamasya apa yakshmam ni dadhmasi |
tan ma prapatprithivim mota devan divam ma prapadurvantariksham |
apo ma prapan malametadagne yamam ma prapatpitrimshcha sarvan ||

verses.sa:
सं त्वा नह्यामि पयसा पृथिव्याः सं त्वा नह्यामि पयसौषधीनाम् ।
सं त्वा नह्यामि प्रजया धनेन सा संनद्धा सनुहि वाजमेमम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam tva nahyami payasa prithivyah sam tva nahyami payasaushadhinam |
sam tva nahyami prajaya dhanena sa samnaddha sanuhi vajamemam ||

verses.sa:
अमोऽहमस्मि सा त्वं सामाहमस्म्यृक्त्वं द्यौरहं पृथिवी त्वम् ।
ताविह सं भवाव प्रजामा जनयावहै ॥
verses.rom:
amo'hamasmi sa tvam samahamasmyriktvam dyauraham prithivi tvam |
taviha sam bhavava prajama janayavahai ||

verses.sa:
जनियन्ति नावग्रवः पुत्रियन्ति सुदानवः ।
अरिष्टासू सचेवहि बृहते वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
janiyanti navagravah putriyanti sudanavah |
arishtasu sachevahi brihate vajasataye ||

verses.sa:
ये पितरो वधूदर्शा इमं वहतुमागमन् ।
ते अस्यै वध्वै संपत्न्यै प्रजावच्छर्म यच्छन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
ye pitaro vadhudarsha imam vahatumagaman |
te asyai vadhvai sampatnyai prajavachchharma yachchhantu ||

verses.sa:
येदं पूर्वागन् रशनायमाना प्रजामस्यै द्रविणं चेह दत्त्वा ।
तां वहन्त्वगतस्यानु पन्थां विराडियं सुप्रजा अत्यजैषीत् ॥
verses.rom:
yedam purvagan rashanayamana prajamasyai dravinam cheha dattva |
tam vahantvagatasyanu pantham viradiyam supraja atyajaishit ||

verses.sa:
प्र बुध्यस्व सुबुधा बुध्यमाना दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय ।
गृहान् गच्छ गृहपत्नी यथासो दीर्घं त आयुः सविता कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
pra budhyasva subudha budhyamana dirghayutvaya shatasharadaya |
grihan gachchha grihapatni yathaso dirgham ta ayuh savita krinotu ||

prose.en:
1. For thee in the beginning they carried about Sūryā, together with the bridal-car; mayest thou, O Agni, give to us husbands the wife, together with progeny.

2. Agni hath given back the spouse, together with life-time, with splendor; of long life-time, may he who is the husband of her live a hundred autumns.

3. Soma's wife first; the Gandharva thy next husband; Agni thy third husband; thy fourth, one of human birth.

4. Soma gave to the Gandharva; the Gandharva gave to Agni; both wealth and sons hath Agni given to me, likewise this woman.

5. Your favor hath come, O ye (two) of abundant good things (? vājínīvasu); [our] desires have rested in [your] hearts, O Açvins; ye have been twin keepers, O lords of beauty; may we, being dear, attain favorers (aryamán) of our homes (? dúrya).

6. Do thou (f.), rejoicing with propitious mind, assign wealth having all heroes, to be extolled; an easy crossing (tīrthá), well provided with drink, O lords (du.) of beauty; do ye smite away the pillar standing in the road, [namely] disfavor.

7. What herbs [there are], what streams, what fields, what forests—let these, O bride, defend from the demon thee, possessing progeny, for thy husband.

8. We have mounted this road, easy, bringing welfare, on which a hero takes no harm, [but] finds others' goods.

9. Pray hear ye now of me, O men, by what blessing (āçís) the two spouses attain what is agreeable (vāmá): what Gandharvas [there are] and heavenly Apsarases, who stand upon these forest trees (vānaspatyá), let them be pleasant unto this bride; let them not injure the bridal-car as it is driven.

10. What yákṣmas go to the bride's brilliant (candrá) car among the people, let the worshipful gods conduct those back whence they came.

11. Let not the waylayers who pursue (ā-sad) [them] find the two spouses; let them go over what is difficult by an easy [road]; let the niggards run away.

12. I cause the bridal-car to be viewed by the houses with worship (bráhman), with a friendly, not terrible eye; what of all forms is fastened on about, let Savitar make that pleasant for the husbands.

13. Propitious hath this woman come to the home; Dhātar appointed this world (sphere) to her; her let Aryaman, Bhaga, both Açvins, Prajāpati, increase with progeny.

14. [As] a soulful cultivated field hath this woman come; in her here, O men, scatter ye seed; she shall give birth to progeny for you from her belly (vakṣáṇās), bearing the exuded (dugdhá) sperm of the male (ṛṣabhá).

15. Stand firm; virā́j art thou; as it were, Vishṇu here, O Sarasvatī; O Sinīvālī, let her have progeny; may she be in the favor of Bhaga.

16. Let your wave smite up the pegs; O waters, release the yoke-ropes (yóktra); let not the two inviolable [kine], not evil-doing, free from guilt, come upon what is unpropitious (? áçuna).

17. With an eye not terrible, not husband-slaying, pleasant, helpful (çagmá), very propitious, of easy control (suyáma) for the houses, hero-bearing, loving brothers-in-law (?), with favoring mind—may we thrive together with thee.

18. Not brother-in-law-slaying, not husband-slaying be thou here, propitious to the cattle, of easy control, very splendid, having progeny, hero-bearing, loving brothers-in-law (?), pleasant, do thou worship (sapary) this householder's fire.

19. Stand up from here; desiring what hast thou (f.) come hither? I [am] thine overcomer, O Iḍā, out of [my] own house; thou that hast come hither, O perdition, seeking the empty—stand up, O niggard; fly forth; rest not here.

20. When this bride hath worshiped the householder's, the former (pū́rva) fire, then, O woman, do thou pay homage to Sarasvatī and to the Fathers.

21. Take this protection, defense, to spread under this woman; O Sinīvālī, let her have progeny; may she be in the favor of Bhaga.

22. What rushes (bálbaja) ye cast down, and [what] hide ye spread under, that let the girl (kanyā̀) of good progeny mount, who finds a husband.

23. Spread under the rushes upon the red hide; sitting down upon it, of good progeny, let her worship this fire.

24. Mount the hide; sit by the fire; this god slays all the demons; here give birth to progeny for this husband; may this son of thine be of good primogeniture.

25. Let there come forth (vi-sthā) from the lap of this mother animals (paçú) of various forms, being born; as one of excellent omen, sit thou by this fire; with thy husband (sámpatnī), be thou serviceable to the gods here.

26. Of excellent omen, extender (pratáraṇa) of the houses, very propitious to thy husband, wealful to thy father-in-law, pleasant to thy mother-in-law, do thou enter these houses.

27. Be thou pleasant to fathers-in-law, pleasant to husband, to houses, pleasant to all this clan; pleasant unto their prosperity (puṣṭá) be thou.

28. Of excellent omen is this bride; come together, see her; having given unto her good-fortune, go asunder and away with ill-fortunes.

29. What evil-hearted young women, and likewise what old ones, [are] here—do ye all sám now give splendor to her; then go asunder and away home.

30. The gold-cushioned (? prastaraṇa) vehicle, bearing all forms, did Sūryā, Savitar's daughter, mount, in order to great good-fortune.

31. Mount the couch with favoring mind; here give birth to progeny for this husband; like Indrāṇī, waking with good awakening, mayest thou watch to meet dawns tipped with light.

32. The gods in the beginning lay with (ni-pad) their spouses; they embraced (sam-spṛç) bodies with bodies; like Sūryā, O woman, all-formed, with greatness, having progeny, unite (sam-bhū) here with thy husband.

33. Stand up from here, O Viçvāvasu; with homage do we praise thee; seek thou a sister (jāmí) sitting among the Fathers, inserted (? nyàktām); that is thy portion by right of birth; know thou that.

34. The Apsarases revel a joint reveling, between the oblation-holder and the sun; they are thy birthplace; go away to them; homage I pay thee with the Gandharva-season.

35. Homage to the Gandharva's mind (?), and homage to his terrible (bhā́ma) eye we pay; O Viçvāvasu, homage [be] to thee with worship (bráhman); go away unto thy wives, the Apsarases.

36. With wealth may we be well-willing; we have made the Gandharva go (vṛt) up from here; that god hath gone to the highest station (sadhástha); we have gone where they lengthen out [their] life-time.

37. Unite (sam-sṛj), O ye (two) parents (pitṛ́), the (two) things that are seasonable; ye shall be mother and father of seed; as a male (márya) a female (yóṣā), do thou mount her; make ye (two) progeny; here enjoy (puṣ) wealth.

38. Send, O Pūshan, her, most propitious, in whom men scatter seed (bī́ja); who, eager, shall part our thighs; in whom we, eager, may insert the member.

39. Mount thou the thigh; apply the hand; embrace thy wife with well-willing mind; make ye (two) progeny here, enjoying; let Savitar make for you a long life-time.

40. Let Prajāpati generate progeny for you (two); let Aryaman unite (sam-añj) [you] with days-and-nights; not ill-omened, enter thou this world of thy husband; be weal to our bipeds, weal to [our] quadrupeds.

41. This bridal garment and bride's dress, given by the gods together with Manu, whoso gives to a knowing (cikitvā́ṅs) priest (brahmán), he verily slays the demons of the couch (?).

42. What priest's portion they (dual) give to me the bride-seeker (vadhūyú), the bridal garment and bride's dress, do ye, O Brihaspati and Indra, assenting, together give it to the priest (brahmán).

43. Awaking out of a pleasant lair (yóni), mightily enjoying yourselves, merry, having good kine, good sons, good houses, may ye, living, pass the outshining dawns.

44. Clothing myself anew, fragrant, well-dressed, I have risen alive unto the outshining dawns; as a bird from the egg, I have been released out of all sin.

46. Unto Sūryā, unto the gods, unto Mitra and Varuṇa, unto them who are forethoughtful of that which exists, have I paid this homage.

47. He who, without a clamp (? abhiçríṣ), before the piercing of the neck-ropes (? jatrú), combines (sam-dhā) a combination—he the bountiful, the one of much good—removes again what is spoiled (víhruta).

48. Away from us let the darkness shine (vas), that is deep blue, brown (piçán̄ga), also red; she who is consuming, spotted, her I fasten (ā-saj) on this pillar.

49. How many witchcrafts in the outer garment (? upavā́sana), how many fetters of king Varuṇa, what failures, what non-successes—them I cause to sit upon this pillar.

50. What is my dearest self (tanū́), that of me is afraid of the garment; of it do thou, O forest-lord, make first (ágre) for thyself an inner wrap (nīví); let us not suffer harm.

51. What ends [there are], how many edges (síc), what webs, and what lines; what garment woven by the spouses—may that touch us pleasantly.

52. Eager, these young girls, going to a husband from the father's world, have let go the consecration: hail!

53. Her, let go by Brihaspati, all the gods maintained; what splendor is entered into the kine, with that do we unite this woman.

54. Her, let go etc. etc.; what brilliancy (téjas) is entered etc. etc.

55. Her, let go etc. etc.; what fortune (bhága) is entered etc. etc.

56. Her, let go etc. etc.; what glory is entered etc. etc.

57. Her, let go etc. etc.; what milk (páyas) is entered etc. etc.

58. Her, let go etc. etc.; what sap is entered etc. etc.

59. If these hairy people have danced together in thy house, doing evil with wailing—from that sin let Agni and Savitar release thee.

60. If this daughter of thine has wailed with loosened hair (vikeçá) in thy house, doing evil with wailing—from that sin etc. etc.

61. If (yát) sisters (jāmí), if young women, have danced together in thy house, doing evil with wailing—from that sin etc. etc.

62. If in thy progeny, in thy cattle, or in thy houses is settled (ni-sthā) any evil done by the evil-doers—from that sin etc. etc.

63. This woman, scattering shrivelled grains (pū́lya) appeals: be my husband long-lived; may he live a hundred autumns.

64. Here, O Indra, do thou push together these two spouses like two cakravākás; let them, with [their] progeny, well-homed, live out all their life-time.

65. What is done on the chair (āsandī́), on the cushion (upadhā́na), or what on the covering (upavā́sana); what witchcraft they have made at the wedding (vivāhá)—that do we deposit in the bath.

66. What ill deed, what pollution at the wedding, and what on the bridal car—that difficulty do we wipe off on the dress (kambalá) of the wooer.

67. Having settled the defilement on the wooer, the difficulty on the dress, we have become worshipful, cleansed (çudh); may he extend our life-times.

68. The artificial hundred-toothed comb (?) that is here shall scratch away the defilement of the hair of her, away that of her head.

69. Away from every limb of her do we deposit the yákṣma; let that not attain (pra-āp) the earth nor the gods; let it not attain the heaven, the wide atmosphere; let that defilement not attain the waters, O Agni; let it not attain Yama and all the Fathers.

70. I gird thee with the milk of the earth; I gird thee with the milk of the herbs; I gird thee with progeny, with riches; do thou, being girded, win (ā-san) this strength (? vā́ja).

71. He am I, she thou; chant am I, verse thou; heaven I, earth thou; let us (two) come together here; let us generate progeny.

72. The unmarried of us seek a wife, the liberal seek a son; may we (two), with uninjured life-breath, be companions (sac), in order to what is great, to winning of strength (? vā́ja-).

73. What bride-beholding Fathers have come to this bridal-car, let them bestow on this bride, with her husband, protection accompanied with progeny.

74. She who hath come hither before, girdling herself (?), having given to this woman here progeny and property—her let them carry along the road of what is not gone; this one, a virā́j, having good progeny, hath conquered.

75. Continue thou awake, waking with good awakening, unto length of life of a hundred autumns; go to the houses that thou mayest be house-mistress; let Savitar make for thee a long life-time.
